Ritsumeikan Center for Game Studies physical-package record PACKAGE0010204 identifies this catalogued Japanese issue by its transcribed 型番 and 商品識別コード. Product code spelling is preserved verbatim; it is not a code inferred from a manual URL, platform, or expected prefix. The catalogue’s own physical metadata is used at museum tier; embedded Wikipedia summaries and externally sourced release dates are not used. Nintendo supplies the release date. A product code/EAN identifies an issue but does not establish every manufacturing revision or universal pack-in contents.

The catalog_* feature strings retain bibliographic extents exactly as reported. Three-axis package/media measurements have no labelled axes or inside/outside convention here, so they are not converted into a closed envelope or internal fit. The single manual-size value is not a complete trim. The reported page extent does not specify whether covers are counted; edition.booklet.pages therefore remains null. These are evidence for further source research, not print-ready dimensions or verified geometry.
